metadata.name: systemd-analyze
metadata.description: Analyze systemd boot and service performance

installation.note: systemd-analyze is part of systemd and available on systemd-based systems

overview.summary: systemd-analyze reports boot time and can show which services took the longest to start. It helps identify slow boot causes and optimize startup. Use blame, critical-chain, and plot for detailed analysis.

syntax.description: Without subcommand, shows total boot time. Subcommands: blame, critical-chain, plot, time, etc.

options.description: Show time spent in each unit at boot
Show critical chain of units (what blocked boot)
Print total boot time (same as no subcommand)

examples.title: Total boot time
examples.description: Show kernel and userspace boot time

examples.title: Slowest services
examples.description: List units by time spent initializing

examples.title: Critical chain
examples.description: Show chain of units that delayed boot
